sm: This article from LifeNews cites a Second Street study finding that at least 29,468 Canadians died while waiting for medical tests or treatment between April 2025 and March 2026, and at least 129,468 since 2018. The author stresses the data is incomplete: Saskatchewan reported only surgical waitlist deaths, most provinces had no figures on waits for specialists, and in Ontario deaths are logged only because software lets staff click "patient died" when cancelling a procedure. The author says Second Street did not track people who chose euthanasia instead of waiting, but cites cases suggesting some do, including Jolene Van Alstine, Dan Quayle, and Allison Ducluzeau. Van Alstine and Ducluzeau were later treated in the United States. The previous year's report counted at least 15,474 deaths, estimated at 28,077 after adjusting for missing data.
